mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled, m.is_virtual, l.code AS location_code FROM scm_trade_draft_item i LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id WHERE i.draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY i.sort, i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO scm_trade_draft_item (draft_id, order_item_id, material_id, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_no, production_date, expiry_date, qty, price, tax_rate, gift, unit_name, serial_nos, remark, sort, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.draftId}, #{i.orderItemId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.warehouseId}, #{i.locationId}, #{i.batchNo}, #{i.productionDate}, #{i.expiryDate}, #{i.qty}, #{i.price}, #{i.taxRate}, #{i.gift}, #{i.unitName}, #{i.serialNos}, #{i.remark}, #{i.sort}, NOW(), NOW())
